Laguna Lake Residences Aster

Condominium in Laguna Phuket, Bang Tao / Cherng Talay
HomeNew ProjectsLaguna Lake Residences Aster

Marketing images, mostly artist renders. Layouts and finishes may differ from the completed project.

Project overview

Laguna Lake Residences Aster is a lakeside condominium by Laguna Property, the development arm of Banyan Group, inside the Laguna Phuket resort community. It offers 1- to 3-bedroom units of about 56 to 113 sqm, with a rooftop infinity pool overlooking the lake. The project is a short walk from the Boat Avenue and Porto de Phuket dining and retail area.

Facilities & amenities

  • 60 m rooftop infinity pool overlooking the lake
  • Covered parking
  • Landscaped gardens
  • Sky garden
  • Kids' play area
  • Convenience shop
  • 24/7 security and concierge
  • Community: 18-hole golf course
  • Community: 24-hour medical clinic
  • Community: beach club
  • Community: SILK International Kindergarten
  • Community: inter-resort shuttle
  • Community: Sanctuary Club membership
